dedupeText: retro soul carousel cover vintage soul carousel horse cowboy hats psychedelic typography 1960s photography denim jackets the subjects are tightly grouped in the center interacting with carousel horse props the large orange display title at the top creates a heavy visual header the vertical lines of the carousel poles provide a rhythmic background structure the high contrast white sans serif text balances the heavier stylized title combine a centered group portrait in period specific costume with a heavy rounded display font at the top and a clean sans serif subtitle all processed through a warm vintage film filter

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a group of four men in Western-inspired attire posing on a carousel. The image uses a warm, slightly faded color palette typical of 1960s film, topped with bold, stylized display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The subjects are tightly grouped in the center, interacting with carousel horse props.
The large, orange display title at the top creates a heavy visual header.
The vertical lines of the carousel poles provide a rhythmic background structure.
The high-contrast white sans-serif text balances the heavier stylized title.
coreInvariants: Carousel horse elements in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men occupy the central 70% of the frame in a tiered arrangement.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange title at the top edge acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down through the faces of the group, and settles on the carousel horse details in the lower corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and background carousel poles.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and browns from denim and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange for the main title text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary text and highlights on the carousel horses.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, yellowish cast; high value contrast in the typography.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the display title
Thin black outlines on the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters are nearly perfect circles with small counters
The 'G' has a deep, rounded bowl

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Two words split by central gap

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy stylized display paired with a clean, functional Swiss-style sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded, 70s-adjacent geometry of the title.
Matches the clean, functional look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium-shot photograph of four men in 1960s cowboy attire (denim jackets, hats, neckerchiefs) posing on a vintage carousel horse. The lighting is warm and slightly diffused with visible film grain. Background shows vertical carousel poles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, orange, ultra-bold rounded display title at the top with a thin black outline. Below it, add a white bold sans-serif subtitle split across the center.

verificationChecks: Title letters are touching or nearly touching.
Color palette is warm and vintage-toned.
Secondary text is clean white sans-serif.

adjustableVariables: Specific placement of the carousel poles
mustRedesign: Exact text content of the small metadata at the bottom
postGenerationChecks: Does the image look like a scanned vinyl cover?
Is the orange title the most prominent visual element?
Are the carousel horses clearly visible as props?
Is the film grain consistent across the image?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a centered group portrait in period-specific costume with a heavy, rounded display font at the top and a clean sans-serif subtitle, all processed through a warm vintage film filter.
